title: fix: delay community model unhiding
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Applies the existing 12-hour publication delay to owner-triggered unhiding of public community models
- Keeps private model unhiding immediate and preserves monitor-managed recovery
- Restores the monitor recovery eligibility window to one hour
- Adds focused integration coverage for before and after the deadline

Test: `npx vitest run test/integration/community-endpoint-price-delay.test.ts` (12 passed)

gist.headline: The garden waits twelve hours
gist.blurb: Public community models now take the same 12-hour scenic route when their owners unhide them. Private models can still pop back out immediately, while the monitor keeps its one-hour rescue window.
gist.summary: Owner-triggered unhiding of public community models now respects the existing 12-hour publication delay, while private-model unhiding remains immediate and monitor-managed recovery remains eligible for one hour.
gist.impact: Community model visibility now behaves consistently around the 12-hour publication deadline, with immediate private recovery and a focused one-hour automated recovery path preserved.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community-model garden with a public flower bed behind a friendly gate and a large pixel clock set to 12 hours, while a smaller private flower bed has an open gate. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener's hat and holding a clipboard, observes the scheduled bloom; the CRT monitor robot tends a small recovery plant beside a one-hour timer, representing the preserved monitor recovery window.
